# Fione Brecht

> **Mercenary Captain (Gold 1) infame** hire des **Threshers** Toppenheimer Sudenland. **Obsessed with subterfuge + conspiracy** + Tzeentch worshipper. False flag raids Stirland/Averland villages en uniforme Nuln (sous lui buff Sudenland). **À NE PAS CONFONDRE** avec [[Brecht Kavenner]] (Arc précédent, différent).

## Identité publique
- **Titre** : **Captain mercenary Threshers** — *« infamously cunning mercenary captain »* (canon ch.9 l.297).
- **Carrière canon** : **Human Officer (Gold 1)**.
- **Apparence canon (ch.9 l.305-308)** : *« obsessed with playing her part in the convoluted chain of events that leads to the end of the world. Obsessed with subterfuge and disinformation. All her communications are done in convoluted codes. Her orders to her warband are made with an impenetrable series of complex gestures and grunts. This actually serves to slow the communication and sow confusion in her own side »*.
- **Personnalité** : *« obsessed with the many rumours of conspiracy and intrigue that are gossiped around the Empire. She believes every one and also believes it is her duty to support them. Conspiracy is a means to its own end. Actual conspiracy is largely irrelevant. This makes the 'cults within cults' approach favored in Tzeentch worship ideal for her. If taken alive, will only answer questions with obscure riddles and acrostics »*.
- **Statut** : [VIVANTE — ENNEMIE ACTIVE]

## Threshers (ch.9 l.294)

- **Toppenheimers hire** for « making life difficult for the countess » Emmanuelle Nuln.
- **Pose comme soldats Nuln + sous-couche uniforme Sudenland**.
- **Faux flag attacks villages** Stirland + Averland → blame Nuln retaliation.
- **Detection canon** : *« only requires an Average (+20) Observation Test for a witness to compare the two to see that the Sudenland uniforms are old and well made, whereas the Goat ones are neither »* (canon ch.9 l.299).

### Background canon ch.9 l.296
*« To further hide their true origins, Brecht has used the cunning ruse of having some of her soldiers wear the dress of fictitious independent mercenary regiment 'The Goats', who wear blue and white uniforms with a goat's head emblem beneath their Nuln garb, whereas others wear the buff uniforms of the Sudenland army, their actual colours. When her troops asked why, she only answered with a sly smile and a wink »*.

### Arc 7 ch.9 Heidheinheim raid
- **[S?]** — **Heidheinheim village raid** (Stirland bank Aver). 8 carts Carroburg arrive. Threshers massively outnumbered. Brecht **last to run, stands chance captured**.
